text:
Ravi M.: just finished a bring-up of magnum-20b-int4-compact on staging. ran the long-window kv-integrity bench (16k/64k/130k). noticed reproducible mismatch only after a cross-chunk compaction event.
Sara T.: can you share a minimal repro? difflog?
Ravi M.: minimal command: `run-onboard --model magnum-20b-int4-compact --bench kv-long-window --seed 7 --prefill 65536 --compaction-threshold 131072`
Ravi M.: difflog snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T09:10:12Z] PREFILL completed tokens=65536
[2026-04-02T09:10:12Z] KV-COMPACT start shards=2->1
[2026-04-02T09:10:12Z] KV-COMPACT end duration=4ms
[2026-04-02T09:10:12Z] GENERATE idx=65537 expected="ing" got="en"
```
Noah B.: sounds like a RoPE index mapping problem during compaction; compaction rewrites KV ordering which affects position indices. only int4-compact repro?
Ravi M.: yes, int8 and fp16 are clean. also ran the unpack reference path (slow) and it matches fp16, so it's in the compact pack/unpack+compaction codepath.
Sara T.: two quick suspects: 1) per-chunk rotary scaling table reused after compaction without rebase, 2) alignment/padding lost when we merge odd-sized chunks.
Ravi M.: added lightweight asserts to compare rot_scale arrays before and after compaction; mismatch seen when chunk lengths differ by odd padding.
Noah B.: try forcing deterministic padding bytes (0xAA) in the packer and see if mismatch persists. if it vanishes then it's an alignment artifact.
Ravi M.: did that—mismatch persisted. digging into index remap table used during compaction. found an off-by-one in remap when remaining_tokens % compact_unit == 0.
Sara T.: ah. remap table generation probably assumed >0 remainder and skipped the boundary fix.
Ravi M.: quick fix: clamp remap_offset = (remap_offset + compact_unit) % compact_unit for exact multiples. patch on branch rami/compact-remap-fix. kicked off fuzz plus quant-matrix: int4-compact,int4-hybrid,int8,fp16 across 16k/64k/131k.
ci-bot: job rami/compact-remap-fix long-kv-fuzz queued (job id: 2026-04-02-4001). ETA 2h.
Ravi M.: also added csv output with columns: model,quant,pre_fill,compacted,token_diffs,p50,p95,p99.
Noah B.: if fix holds, add unit that generates boundary case where remaining_tokens % compact_unit == 0 and assert remap idempotence.
Sara T.: agreed. one more perf note: compaction runs on critical path during warmhead for long prefills; we should profile memory copies—compaction avoided copies initially but patch introduces a small extra compute step.
Ravi M.: perf tradeoff is tiny: ~0.01ms per compaction for 8k chunk sizes. filed PF-4210 to track.
qa-bot: fuzz completed: initial sweep showed token_diffs=0 for all prefill sizes on int4-compact after patch (job id: 2026-04-02-4001).
Ravi M.: PR up for review. planning a small canary on dedicated nodes tomorrow with verbose diff sampling for 30m.
